note: Winneshiek County Conservation campground on the Upper Iowa River at Kendallville, six miles north of Cresco on Highway 139. The electric sites have gravel pads; the non-electric sites are primitive (fire ring and post, no pad). Canoe and fishing access to the river, ball diamond, playground. Weekends in the camping season the campground phone is (563) 547-2897. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 38 sites, 50-amp at some, showers, dump, FCFS self-register; added water false (no water hookups), flush + pit toilets, drinking water. Fees low $15 -> $20 (the $15 sites are padless primitive/tent sites). Not waterfront stands, with a riverview lead for the west-end sites.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD not waterfront -> riverview? (for a human; not changed). The 2026 layout and imagery put the outer loop's west end (sites 17-21) on the inner side of the loop road, ~30-40 m from the Upper Iowa, which is ~30 m wide here (river by the 30 m rule). Between pad and water: the campground loop road (which blocks on-water), then a 12-20 m grass strip with scattered trees and a narrow bank fringe; leaf-off imagery shows that strip mostly open. Sites 7-9 on the inner loop's south side are ~30-35 m back behind the outer road and a continuous bank tree belt. No county photo shows the river from a site (the three gallery photos show the open lawn, picnic tables and a bird). So a view is plausible from a few west-end sites but not shown; under the unsure rule it stays not waterfront unless a photo turns up.
FEES: base raised from $15 to $20 because the county lists a gravel camper pad only for the electric sites; the $15 non-electric sites have none and the layout draws them as tent sites.
SEASON: no opening/closing dates posted; the page's 'Update 10/26/2026: Kendallville Campground is closed for the season.' is the ordinary seasonal close, not a status.
PIN OK (inside the main loop). Website and office phone (563) 534-7145 confirmed.
FIT: no lengths posted; a county gallery photo shows a large Class A motorhome on the lawn sites.
